_note: Mock catalog of places where knowledge lives. S01-S03 are real public regulator sources; S04-S16 are fictional internal sources of 'Sample Bank'. In a real deployment this list comes from the data catalog, document management system, Confluence/SharePoint indexes and the application inventory.

sources.title: RBI Master Direction on KYC and AML circulars
sources.description: Obligations of regulated entities under PMLA: customer due diligence, monitoring of transactions, and reporting of cash and suspicious transactions to FIU-IND, with clarifications and illustrations.

sources.title: FIU-IND Reporting Format Guide and XML schemas
sources.description: Technical specification of CTR, STR and NTR reports: account-based and transaction-based XML formats, mandatory fields, data quality rules, report types including replacement reports, and the report validation utility.

sources.title: FIU-IND FAQs
sources.description: Frequently asked questions on reporting obligations, thresholds, due dates and filing on the FINGate portal.

sources.title: AML Compliance interpretation memos
sources.description: Compliance department notes recording how the bank interprets regulatory terms, scope choices and exceptions, approved by the Principal Officer.

sources.title: CTR Working Group minutes and decision log
sources.description: Minutes and decisions of the CTR working group on channel scope, cash deposit machines and changes to reporting.

sources.title: Treasury Rate Policy TRP-2023
sources.description: Treasury policy defining card rates, reference rates and publication times used for foreign currency conversion.

sources.title: CoreOne data dictionary
sources.description: Tables and fields of the CoreOne core banking system: transaction history, customer master, account master, branch and code values.

sources.title: CoreOne transaction code and channel master
sources.description: Parameter tables listing transaction type codes and channel codes (teller, ATM, cash deposit machine, internet) and what each means.

sources.title: Customer MDM and UCIC design
sources.description: Design of the unique customer identification code, account-to-customer linkage and de-duplication rules in master data management.

sources.title: Enterprise data catalog and lineage
sources.description: Catalog of data assets with owners, business glossary terms and lineage from source systems to reporting marts.

sources.title: AML Operations SOP and reporting calendar
sources.description: Standard operating procedures for AML operations: monthly reporting calendar, review and sign-off steps, maker-checker controls.

sources.title: Previous CTR BRDs and change requests
sources.description: Earlier versions of the CTR requirements and JIRA change requests, with the rationale for each change.

sources.title: Internal audit and inspection findings
sources.description: Findings from internal audit and regulatory inspections on AML reporting, with management responses.

sources.title: Teller and voucher system specification
sources.description: Branch teller application specification: cash voucher fields captured for walk-in customers such as PAN or Form 60, denominations and depositor details.

sources.title: Group AML Policy AML-POL-07
sources.description: Board-approved AML policy covering customer acceptance, monitoring and regulatory reporting responsibilities.

sources.title: Subject-matter experts (Principal Officer's team)
sources.description: People who hold undocumented knowledge of past practice and interpretations; reached by interview.
